verdict.rationale: Poke provides a browsable directory at poke.com/recipes covering first-party and approved third-party recipes/integrations (GitHub, Linear, Webflow, etc.), plus the ability to connect any MCP-compatible server directly if a service isn't pre-built as a recipe. Users can add, disconnect, or reconnect integrations via clear UI actions. missing for 10: independent/hands-on corroboration of the directory's breadth and usability beyond vendor docs.
